name: cx-goal-one-rule~p3
task: Open the door, then take the box from the other room; try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the soft Absence(key_lost) correctly captures “try not to drop the key while the door is still closed,” but it does not require opening the door or taking the box. Add hard Existence(target_picked_up) and hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up); together they require the box and the stated order, and force the door to be opened. The empty FINAL_STATES confirms no hard goal is currently required.

texts: The agent eventually picks up the target box.
The door is opened before the target box is picked up.
The agent does not lose the key while the door is still closed.
